newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-ROMANIAN TEENAGER LIFTS ANDERLECHT HOPES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIAN TEENAGER LIFTS ANDERLECHT HOPES.

text.p: Romanian teenager Alin Stoica came on as an 85th minute substitute and scored a last minute goal as Anderlecht beat Ukrainians Vorskla Poltava 2-0 in a UEFA Cup second preliminary round, first leg match on Tuesday.
Anderlecht's new Danish signing Dan Petersen opened the scoring in the 18th minute.
The Belgians, UEFA Cup winners in 1983 and quarter-finalists last season, wasted several chances and faded dramatically until 17-year-old Stoica struck from 20 metres out.
